description: This file defines the EntityReferenceFieldItemNormalizer class, which extends FieldItemNormalizer to handle normalization of entity reference field items in Drupal, including adding URL and UUID information for referenced entities.

classes.name: EntityReferenceFieldItemNormalizer
classes.description: Normalizer class for entity reference field items, adding URL and UUID info for referenced entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects the entity repository dependency.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a field item, adding target type, UUID, and URL information.

methods.name: constructValue
methods.description: Constructs a value array for the entity reference, loading the entity by UUID.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns supported types for normalization, specifically EntityReferenceItem.
